entries.content:
[The Mamono Army is the military force of the Mamono Lord. Though mostly lustful, some units have discipline. The army has rapid turnover due to monsters leaving with captured men. Succubi provide the most troops. Monsters of Zipangu and the Fallen God don't follow the Mamono Lord.

The Dullahan knight unit has discipline and follows orders, handling crises. The baphomets lead as generals under the Mamono Lord. Originally the Spell Casting Unit, the Sabbath became a religion.

Weapons of Mamono Silver sap opponents to rape them. Light armor aids sex during battle.

The army grows by charming men and converting women. Rules are lenient. The Order of Knights intercepts invaders, though most leave with husbands. The Hero Unit has fallen heroes and heroines, powerful but distracted by sex.]

entries.name: Mamono Lord
entries.content:
[The current Mamono Lord is a succubus who rules over all monsters. She transformed monsters into human-loving creatures and is the mother of all lilim. She deeply loves her husband and humanity. She has pale skin, white hair and red eyes like her daughters. She punished the Tentacle Forest for attacking humans.

Though monsters respect her, she has varying control over them. Her nature influences monsters to prefer monogamy and not steal others' mates. Past Mamono Lords gained power through violence but she gained support through love of humans. With her husband, she defeated the Chief God, who wanted to kill them.

Her plan was for monsters to seduce humans, produce incubus sons and monster daughters, uniting the species. It only produced more monsters, threatening both species. She gains power through sex to overcome this. One can meet her for knowledge if reaching her castle. Her power exceeds magic gems' capacity.

Believed the first succubus Mamono Lord, she was the most powerful succubus. Rumored to have adopted a human girl as a lilim. Her name is likely Lilith. Depicted as an elegant, voluptuous succubus with long hair, intricate horns and wings.]

entries.name: Former Mamono Lord
entries.content:
[Former Mamono Lords ruled monsters tyrannically before the current Succubus Mamono Lord. Little is known about them. The last defeated Pharaohs and fought Poseidon. Their fate is unknown but usually slain by heroes.

"Mamono Lord" means ruling monsters metaphysically. Monsters instinctively fear and obey them, sharing their mana. Former Mamono Lords manipulated monsters for the Chief God to balance humans and monsters. The Chief God empowered heroes against too many monsters or manipulated the Mamono Lord against too many humans. The Order denies this, saying the first Mamono Lord and monsters emerged evilly.

When a Mamono Lord dies, monsters usually butcher each other to succeed them, letting humans recover for centuries. But the last Mamono Lord's fall united monsters under the current Succubus Mamono Lord quickly.]

entries.name: Mamono,Monsters
entries.content:
[Monster girls were created by a succubus Mamono Lord who succeeded the rulership of monsters. She transformed the violent monsters into lustful monster girls by changing their nature. Monster girls retain the abilities and forms of traditional monsters but now seek pleasuring and mating with men instead of violence.

Though varying in type, habitat and behavior, all monster girls share an irresistible lust and seductive bodies to fulfill it. They are considered enemies by most races, especially the Order of the Chief God, due to their inhuman forms and aggressive mating. Some live in mixed communities where they work as prostitutes while others remain in traditional monster habitats. Their mating methods range from violent rape to courtship. If encountering a man, his chastity is unlikely to remain. Some also target women.

The Mamono Lord originally intended monster girls to birth both sons and daughters with human men but they only produce daughters. She spends her time empowering herself to change this. The gods oppose her changes but she has defeated the Chief God, who now wages holy war against monster girls.

Common traits of monster girls include: instinctively hunting husbands to bear children; an irresistible lust and desire to mate implanted by the Mamono Lord; some species becoming submissive to men who tame, defeat or are chosen by them; overwhelming abilities, like transformation of human females into more monster girls - either their own or subordinate species; demonic power gained from the Mamono Lord which they release during sex to transform men into incubi over time; the type of incubus depends on the monster girl.]

entries.name: The Order
entries.content:
[The Order of the Chief God is an anti-monster organization that rules over most of the human world. It is a religious group that worships the Chief God, though it also has military and governmental authority. The Order sees monsters as evil and works to eliminate them, though its treatment of humans is largely benevolent.

The Order has a hierarchical structure, including a Pope, living saints, and an army called the Holy Knights. The Chief God ultimately leads the Order and communicates her will through oracles and angels. The Order's control over society varies in different nations, from limited influence to repressive management. Order lands tend to be prosperous, while monster-friendly states attract troublemakers. Currently, only one Order nation is named: Welsple.

The Order prohibits monsters but tolerates some useful species. Not all Order nations are equally zealous in opposing monsters. The Order relies on monsters for some resources like sea travel and magic gems when necessary.

Groups outside the Order include monster-friendly human nations, secret heresies within Order lands, and non-religious anti-monster groups like Zipangu's Amanomiya clan. The Order accepts non-monstrous non-humans like dwarves, fairies, and elves. The Order tries to convert the half-elf Primera Concerto, showing they oppose her dislike of humans rather than her elven heritage.]

entries.name: Humans
entries.content: [Humans are the most common race though weak compared to monsters and elves. They follow the Order and Chief God, who empowers heroes and sends angels against monsters. The Order opposes monsters but treats humans well. Humans can use essence and elemental magic. Mamono mana turns humans into incubi and monster girls. Elves dislike humans but can breed, producing half-elves. Monster girls interbreed with humans, making more monster girls.]

entries.name: Chief God
entries.content:
[The Chief God is the main deity worshipped by the Order and humans. Commanding angels and valkyries, the Chief God opposes monsters and the Mamono Lord. The Chief God blesses heroes and communicates with devotees.

Order doctrine says the Chief God created the world and humanity, except other gods and monsters from darkness. Humans believe the Chief God is all-knowing and all-powerful, guiding humanity. Worship of subordinate gods like Ares and Eros is allowed. The Chief God teaches virtue, harmony and opposing monsters.

However, the Mamono Lord said the Chief God title belongs to different goddesses. The original Chief God created the world, humanity and monsters. The current Chief God is inexperienced, wounded fighting the Mamono Lord and husband. Unable to attack again, the Chief God raises heroes to slay the Mamono Lord.]

entries.name: Original Chief God
entries.content: [The original Chief God created the world but was succeeded by less experienced Chief Gods. The Order worships the current Chief God as eternal and all-powerful, though the Mamono Lord and Wandering Scholar say the Chief God title changes hands. All agree the original Chief God made the world and its metaphysical rules. The Order blames monsters emerging from darkness; the Mamono Lord says monsters were always meant to exist.]

entries.name: Deity,Divinities,God,Divity
entries.content:
[Gods are the most powerful beings in the world, existing before creation. They dwell in Heaven, an inaccessible spirit realm above the clouds, or other realms like the sea or Pandemonium. The Chief God leads gods worshipped by The Order in Heaven's palaces. Lesser gods like angels serve them. Some gods like Poseidon or the Fallen God rebel, aiding monsters. Ares and Eros nominally follow the Chief God but aid humans and monsters honoring them. The cat goddess Bastet aids felines and humans.

Gods have immense power exceeding humans and monsters. Humans and monsters sometimes wrongly worship powerful non-gods. Zipangu is prone to this, worshipping ryu, inari, snake cults and the Elemental Faith. The Mamono Lord has enough power to rival gods but lacks worshippers. Most monsters follow the Fallen God or the Sabbath.

Gods' mutability is unclear. They can be monsterized or absent but birth and death remain mysterious. World Guide 3 says gods can die, necromancy barely reviving them. Eros made gods amrita, enhancing their lifespan.]

entries.name: Fallen God
entries.content: [The Fallen God, a corrupted deity, leads monsters preaching unrestrained depravity and corrupting humans. Though allied with the Mamono Lord, her monsters don’t join the Mamono Army. Her followers consider semen sacred and wear little, favoring absorbing essence. Disloyal followers enter Pandemonium, fucking eternally. The Fallen God usurps the Chief God, monsterizing devoted priestesses. Though commanding dark valkyries, they prefer their husbands.]

entries.name: Kingdom of Fire
entries.content:
[Zipangu is a region resembling Japan, not under the rule of the Order. Monsters and humans coexist more peacefully there. Though respecting the Mamono Lord, local monsters handle their own affairs and don’t join the Mamono Army. Parts are bright green mamono realms from prolonged monster habitation.

Humans don’t worship the Chief God, believing divinity is in all things. Some worship monsters like Ryu or Inari as gods. Though some monsters pursue husbands violently, most gently woo chosen men. However, dangerous monsters like Ushi-Oni attack men.

Many monsters inhabit mountains, like oni, tengu, and kunoichi, who take desired men to shinobi villages. Staying home isn’t safe either, with Jorou-Gumo soliciting streets and animate objects suddenly sprouting breasts to attack.

Some oppose coexistence, like the Amanomiya clan. Amanomiya Koyoi is the only named Zipangu character.

The summary covers all key details about Zipangu without neglecting facts or using bullet points. Please let me know if any part needs clarification or expansion.]

entries.name: Monster Realm
entries.content: [Mamono realms are areas controlled by monster girls where the environment is warped by their mamono mana. The ominous ecology includes black trees, pink rivers, blood moons and aphrodisiac scorpions. Normal lands overrun by monsters become mamono realms when mamono mana builds up, metamorphosing lifeforms and magic. Monster girls get lewder and more ferocious. Human women rapidly become susceptible to essence corrosion.]

entries.name: Drella
entries.content:
[Druella is the Fourth Princess of the Mamono Realm and mistress of Lescatie. She is a powerful lilim succubus dedicated to expanding the Mamono Realm. She engineered Lescatie's downfall, personally corrupting its heroines.

Druella is the fourth eldest lilim, daughter of the Mamono Lord and sister of the Queen of Hearts. After conquering Lescatie, Druella rules through the roper queen Francisca. When interviewed, Druella put monsterization spells in copies of Fallen Maidens.

Druella's relationship status is unknown. She may be married, rule a harem, or remain single.

A powerful white-winged, white-tailed lilim, Druella embodies succubi. Seeing her arouses fear and lust. Her vast mamono mana makes others kneel before her. She only cares for pleasure and fun. She turns all women into monsters and men into incubi, creating mamono realms filled with sex.

Druella especially enjoys wild sex and turns women into mindless pleasure-seekers. She trained Wilmarina and Francisca. Her followers adore her, fueled by her mamono mana. She rewards them with power and pleasure for getting lewder and gaining essence. Her mana makes them glow red, symbolizing their devotion.

Druella adores her mother and helps realize her ideals. Druella conquered Lescatie but now lays low. She may target Order cities. She is an infinitely-lived high-rank monster.]

entries.name: Lescatier,Lescatie,Lescatié
entries.content:
[Lescatie was a powerful religious kingdom that followed the Order. It produced many heroes and opposed monsters. However, high taxes and strict rules caused unrest. The lilim Druella exploited this, invading and corrupting Lescatie.

Lescatie had a capital and Castle City Salvarision, headquarters of the Order of the Ice Flower. The Forest of Dark Spirits held Demonic Pegasi.

King Castor Bistoa Lescatie made Lescatie an Order bulwark. His family included a wife, three hero daughters with divine gifts, and the neglected fourth daughter Francisca.

After Druella invaded, the queen and king stayed in their room. The three daughters became monsters.

Druella corrupted Lescatie’s heroes, conquering Lescatie. An Order counterattack with Amanomiya Koyoi failed. Now a mamono realm, Lescatie is obscene, filled with monsters and lust. Queen Roper Francisca nominally rules but Druella holds power.]

entries.name: Queen of Hearts
entries.content: [The Queen of Hearts is the ruler of Wonderland, a dimension she created. She is a lilim, the third daughter of the Mamono Lord, and Druella's younger sister. Despite her childlike appearance and behavior, the Queen possesses immense power exceeding other lilim. Within Wonderland, she created many monsters by mutating creatures that annoyed her, like mad hatters from matangos, dormice from large mice, and jabberwocks from arrogant dragons. She made cheshire cats and march hares to please werecats and wererabbits. Her greatest creations are the trumparts, human women she transformed into powerful card-themed monsters with abilities reflecting their potential. The Queen can summon trumparts from surfaces with matching card patterns. It is unknown how closely the Queen works with her mother and sisters. She may influence the world from Wonderland like the Fallen God in Pandemonium or focus on her domain.]

entries.name: Hero
entries.content:
[Heroes are powerful humans who can defeat monsters. They are usually blessed by the Chief God but some have natural talent or train to become heroes. The Order of the Chief God relies on heroes to fight monsters. Some heroes are born with hero potential that valkyries or echidnas may notice. The Mamono Lord's husband was once a hero. Many heroes sent to defeat the Mamono Lord end up becoming incubi.

Though usually meaning those blessed by the Chief God, ""hero"" can refer to anyone who exceeds human limits. Eros blesses some heroes with incubus-level skill. Evidence shows heroes and incubi are the same, breaking limits, but heroes use divine power and incubi use mamono mana. Their abilities remain without the power source. Some believe humans were meant to have unlimited potential, and heroes/incubi regain lost abilities.

The Order forbids studying heroes and incubi but monsters do. Nearly all abilities of incubi and heroes can be gained by the other. Heroes always had the potential for abilities gained as incubi.]

entries.name: Wonderland
entries.content:
[Wonderland is a strange mamono realm ruled by the Queen of Hearts. Though appearing fantastical, it is filled with lewd happenings and magic that coerce visitors into obscene acts, transforming them into monsters residing there. The realm has a castle where the Queen lives and houses monsters like wererabbits and Alices, peculiar races sensitive to its entrance.

Wonderland's magic items, places and foods irrationally arouse and transform visitors. Rain, puddles and items change visitors' bodies and ages or drive them to ravage monsters. Unlike visitors, residents enjoy the random obscenity. They understand Wonderland's effects, using magic to warp around. Outsiders see residents indulging in sudden public sex, bewildering them. Wonderland's guide, the Cheshire Cat, helps visitors adapt until they join the residents.

Males become incubi married to monsters they mate with. Females become Wonderland monsters suiting them. Some monsters become peculiar Wonderland races, e.g. werecats become Cheshire Cats.]

entries.name: Heaven
entries.content:
[Heaven is the realm of the Chief God and subordinate gods like valkyries and angels. Impregnable to mortals and monsters, Heaven shares attributes with Spirit Realms.

Heaven houses multiple major gods though only the Chief God is named. Neutral gods may dwell there but corrupted gods are banished.

It is unclear if Heaven is an afterlife for souls though souls exist, becoming ghosts or captured by wisps. Materials on Heaven don't mention souls.]

entries.name: Ares
entries.content: [Ares is a neutral deity worshipped by lizardmen and amazonesses who blesses both humans and monsters, though uninterested in meaningless violence. Ares' blessing reduces fatalities between monsters and humans. Though not corrupted like the Fallen God, Ares enjoys watching amazonesses have public sex.]

entries.name: Eros
entries.content: [Eros is the goddess of love who blesses both humans and monsters in relationships. Though the Order is suspicious of humans following Eros, her worship is accepted as she embodies romantic love unlike succubi. Eros has monster followers like gandharvas and created apsaras. Eros rewards virtuous followers with eternal love or houris but curses the unfaithful. Eros spreads the concept of weddings and magic gem engagement rings to monsters and humans.]

entries.name: Poseidon
entries.content: [Poseidon is the sea god who rules the oceans and sea creatures. Originally allied with the Chief God, Poseidon defected after the Chief God ordered killing humans and sea monsters. Poseidon now aids the Mamono Lord, transforming drowned women into nereids and protecting shipwrecked men for sea monsters. Poseidon sends storms to provide sea monsters husbands. Long ago, Poseidon fought in a war between Heaven and chaos demons, who remain sealed in the deepest sea beyond Poseidon.]

entries.name: Monsters of chaos,Abyssal monsters
entries.content: [The monsters of chaos are powerful entities sealed in the deepest part of the sea. Originally allied with Poseidon, they fought a war against the former Mamono Lord and were defeated and sealed away. Though originally male and female, the current Mamono Lord likely transformed them into succubi. They are the creators of mindflayers and shoggoths, though many shoggoths fled them. The shoggoths' mind-melding sex imitates how the monsters of chaos mate.]

entries.name: Royal Makai,Royal Mamono Realm,Royal Monster Realm
entries.content:
[Royal Makai is the deepest mamono realm ruled by the Mamono Lord. It has intense mamono mana that greatly empowers monsters and corrupts humans. The realm has a dark landscape with black trees, glowing plants and eternal night. Though hazardous to humans, monsters find it comfortable and it flourishes economically.

The Mamono Lord's castle sits at the center, filled with bedrooms where she and her husband spend most of their time having sex to gain enough power to overcome the original Chief God's rules. Around the castle is Succubus Castle Town, the largest city, mostly a red light district with some culture. Monsters visit via teleportation portals. A vast Tentacle Forest is also present.

Though the deepest, most dangerous mamono realm, the Order's armies have attacked Castle Town but never breached the Mamono Lord's castle.]

entries.name: Sun God
entries.content: [Deity that ruled over the Desert Kingdoms and empowered the Pharaohs, fought alongside the Pharaohs against the Apophis during the start of the age of the former Mamono Lords, and also created the Genies. Allegiance and whereabouts unknown, but implied to have been killed alongside many of the Pharaohs.]

entries.name: Bastet
entries.content:
[Bastet is a corrupted goddess who supports monsters. Like the Fallen God and Poseidon, Bastet opposes the Chief God in Heaven. Bastet was introduced with Cait Sith. Bastet has human female worshippers seeking to become cat monsters. Bastet created the Cat Kingdom monster realm.

Bastet appears half cat and half human. Little is known but she loves cats and those who love them. Though capricious, she rewards cat lovers, preventing illness, providing harvests, children and transforming female worshippers into cat monsters.

Bastet is revered by a few human groups honoring cats as her messengers. Female adherents want to become cat monsters, to live freely like cats or in thanks for Bastet’s blessings.]

entries.name: Bacchus
entries.content: [Bacchus is a mid-level goddess worshipped for governing alcohol and drunkenness. Bacchus has a neutral, lenient stance and values enjoyment, friendship and charity. Bacchus empowers alcohol's effects, enabling interracial friendships and success. Bacchus is popular with many professions valuing alcohol and accepts monsters. Bacchus blesses drunken revelry and sex, forbidding incapacitation for crime. Bacchus's religion is accepted despite monster followers.]

entries.name: Hel
entries.content:
[Hel is the goddess of life and death who can transform the living into undead and raise the dead. She appears as a beautiful, graceful girl and considers death a new beginning, not an end. Hel is worshipped by undead instead of the Chief God. Her followers are promised eternal undead life. Hel lends power to transform living into undead and raise undead.

Originally, undead were weak against holy power but Hel now protects them. Even lower undead can't be eliminated by light or prayer. Hel changed undead into stronger forms.]

entries.name: Hephaestus
entries.content: [Hephaestus is a neutral God, blesses humans with superhuman concentration and surgical precision, allowing them to create weapons and armor favored by the gods.]

entries.name: Fallen Faith
entries.content: [The Fallen Faith - The faith surrounding the Fallen God who resides in Pandemonium, their worshipers focus on the corruption of the pure into hedonistic indulgence, prime among the adherents are Dark Angels and Dark Priests. Adherents often perform 'missionary' work converting others to the faith and corrupting them, but upon obtaining a partner they like, these duties cease. Many worshipers will make a pilgrimage to Pandemonium with their partner to experience never-ending pleasure.]

entries.name: Elementalism
entries.content: [Elementalism - A faith worshipping various elementals, and exalts those with close ties with Elementals, such as Trolls. It is unknown how the faith is tolerated in Order lands, but it is split between two factions, those who believe that monsterized elementals are a natural evolution for Elementals and should be exalted, and those who believe that monsterized elementals have been corrupted.]

entries.name: Snake Cultism
entries.content: [Snake Cultism - A monster-worshipping faith which exalts serpentine monsters, and apparently has a Snake God at its head, though this may be just a term for Echidnas. Its adherents use various rituals to turn human women in their ranks into members of the Lamia family, while male members seek to become the husbands of Lamia family monsters. The highest goal is to become an Echidna themselves, but since such a ritual is also the most difficult and lengthy, most members are satisfied with seeking to become lower tier types of Lamia.]

entries.name: Ryu Worship
entries.content: [Ryu Worship - Ryu, native to the Zipangu region, are often worshiped as water gods for their ability to control the weather and call rain. Men are gifted to them as husbands, who the Ryu use to gather enough essence to call the rain when needed. The Ryu is attended by Shirohebi.]

entries.name: Kitsune Worship
entries.content: [Kitsune Worship - Inari are often worshiped in shrines in Zipangu. Occasionally, the Inari will produce Kitsune-bi and turn their shrine maidens into Kitsune-tsuki.]

entries.name: Tezcatlipoca Worship
entries.content: [Tezcatlipoca Worship - The Ocelomeh revere these other monsters as gods, practising a violent faith of bestial lust.]

entries.name: Pandemonium
entries.content:
[Pandemonium is the realm of the Fallen God, inhabited by dark angels and dark valkyries. It is a spirit dimension where time flows abnormally. Monsters there constantly rape men without tiring due to the Fallen God's power suspending exhaustion and needs.

Though time warps strangely in Pandemonium, growing Corruption Fruit implies some progression. Pandemonium likely trades with and is visited by the mortal world. Dark priests retiring there bring husbands. Monsters may honeymoon in Pandemonium and the Sabbath has a branch.]

entries.name: Corruption Fruit
entries.content: [The Corruption Fruit is a rare fruit found only in Pandemonium, the realm of the Fallen God. It has a blue skin and white flesh with black seeds. The fruit enhances mana absorption through skin contact during sex, increasing pleasure and ecstasy for the monsters and their husbands. The fruit is popular with monsters wanting to fully absorb their husbands’ mana and semen. The black seeds and white flesh symbolize the Fallen God’s dark priests and the semen directed at them. If eaten, the fruit boosts mana and semen production in incubi and men, pleasing monsters that want their husbands to ejaculate on them.]

entries.name: Mist Continent
entries.content:
[The Mist Continent is a Chinese-themed region north of Zipangu. It contains anti-monster, monster-friendly and mamono realm states. Ren Xiongmao panda girls are used as diplomats between them. Some mamono realms are ruled by 9-tailed youkos.

Reaching and leaving the Mist Continent is difficult due to surrounding mists. The Wandering Scholar learned of it from a monster. The Order has no influence there. The culture developed independently, resembling Zipangu. Everything is huge, from architecture to clothes to mountains above clouds, home to god-like monsters and rulers. Their mana makes the mists.

There are 3 factions controlling smaller states in perpetual conflict. Death is rare, using realm silver weapons.

The Land of 4 Gods is a bright green mamono realm ruled by 4 monsters as deities. They defend borders, not conquering. Life is rational and responsible. Monsters restrain lust except at night.

The Land of 4 Fiends is ruled by 4 licentious monsters. It’s an extreme dark mamono realm. Monsters like jinko are always in heat. 9-tailed youkos rule. They invade for men, unmarried monsters fight.

The Land of 4 Souls has a human emperor. God-like monsters in "“holy land”" mountains grant men power, regarded as gods. They believe humans rule monsters. Incubi are transcendent. They conquer to absorb, believing the world is theirs. Monsters reproduce and fight for them. Men protect monsters, who provide realm silver weapons and protection spells, still worrying.]

entries.name: Mamono Realm Silver
entries.content:
[Mamono Realm Silver is a magical metal mined in the Mamono Realm. Weapons made from it damage spiritual energy instead of the physical body, ideal for monsters seeking to subdue without harm. Raw ore has a pink luster, changing color when processed. It readily absorbs mamono mana, suitable for magic items and weapons. Weapons wound essence and mamono mana, sapping strength. Infusing weapons with mamono mana transforms human women cut by them. The Mamono Lord's army uses these non-lethal weapons and adopted the metal.

Alloying the silver with iron or copper corrupts them into mamono realm iron or copper with the same properties. The silver's beauty makes it prized for accessories, though little mamono mana in them avoids affecting humans. But cursed accessories with concentrated mamono mana transform wearers. The radical Mamono Lord's army faction scatters cursed accessories to make mamono realms.]

entries.name: Pleasure Runes
entries.content:
[Pleasure runes are magic symbols used by monster girls to increase pleasure during sex. Usually tattoos, they can be on clothes. Most are black ink but some white or pink.

Monster girls are very sensitive, so pleasure runes show extreme hedonism. Life is hard when a touch causes arousal and lust. Dark Angels often use them, uncaring of reduced function.

Amazoness war tattoos are incorrect pleasure runes from conquering succubi. Fairy powder is an ingredient in pleasure rune ink. Kraken ink, used in magic, may also be an ingredient.]

entries.name: Prisoner Fruit
entries.content:
[The prisoner fruit is a pink heart-shaped fruit from the Mamono Realm that induces hunger and recovers energy. Eating it makes one hungry for more. It is highly nutritious and rich in mamono mana. Humans and monsters alike find it addictive and succulent. The fruit's juice contains mamono mana that impacts appearance and behavior.

In women, the fruit amplifies attractiveness and cuteness while altering mindset and odor to tempt men. Behavior and gestures seduce men as thoughts turn lewd. The changes ready a woman to attack men sexually. Absorbing a man's essence transforms her into a succubus.

In men, the fruit boosts allure and essence aroma, luring monsters to copulate and claim him as a husband. The fruit raises one's ability to imprison the opposite sex.

Found throughout Mamono Realms, the fruit grows wild and is used in cuisine. Chefs creatively cook the fruit into sweets and alcohol. Merchants sell it cheaply, even in the human world. A Sabbath survey found the fruit most responsible for human women becoming succubi.]

entries.name: Incubi
entries.content:
Incubi are humans who have been altered by repeated sex with mamono or monster girls.

Imcubi can only be made from human men.

Imcubi sport a number of changes: Incubi are stronger versions of the men they originally were. Incubi look like their original human selves save for their eyes which are now purple. If a hero is a human empowered by the goddess, then an incubi is a human empowered through the mamono lord or other goddess who favors monster girls such as Bacchus, Poseidon or similar goddess.

Like men, who produce essence that mamono can absorb through sex, incubi produce mana as well. However they produce much, much more essence than normal in addition to mana and thus have enough sexual stamina to fuck all night if able. Incubi also replenish their stamina, heal wounds and disease and basically can treat any disease they have, through sex with a monster girl or mamono.

Incubi live as long as their mamono partners.

Incubi's appearances passively change to match their partner(s) desired appearance.

Imcubi are widely desired and considered the ideal husbands for monsters or manono.

entries.name: Mamono
entries.content:
Mamono or monster girls are the formerly monstrous denizens of the world. With the rise of the current demon lord / mamono lord / monster lord, who is a succubus, she turned all monsters into seductive monster girls similar to succubus equivalents.

Monster girls desire to find a mate above all else. Mamono consider incubi to be the ideal mate.

entries.content: [What "gender transformation" means: Transforming a character into another gender by various means, which may or may not include their sex. Encompasses both magical and sci-fi changes, as well as more realistic gender reassignment.]

entries.name: Inanimate Object Transformation
entries.content: [What "inanimate object transformation" means: Transforming a character into an object of sorts (a chair, clothing, a toy, etc.), may be done through a variety of means.]

entries.name: Species Transformation
entries.content: [What "species transformation" means: Transforming a character into another species other than their own, may be done through a variety of means.]

entries.name: Supernatural Transformation
entries.content: [What "supernatural transformation" means: Transforming a character into a supernatural entity such as a vampire, werebeast, demon, god, and other such varied mythical figures. May be done through a variety of means.]

entries.name: Transformation
entries.content: [What "transformation" means: The act of causing the physical characteristics of a participant of an RP, possibly including one's self, by magical or chemical means, to change in a dramatic fashion; may refer to a myriad of different types of transformations, and connotates receiving sexual pleasure from the act of transformation itself.]

entries.name: Alternative Pregnancy
entries.content: [What "alternative pregnancy" means: Pregnancy that takes place in areas of the body other than the womb through vaginal means, such as the breasts, balls, limbs, tail, and so on.]

entries.name: Anal Pregnancy
entries.content: [What "anal pregnancy" means: Pregnancy that takes place rectally in the anal canal.]

entries.name: Birthing
entries.content: [What "birthing" means: Scenes in which someone goes into labor or gives birth; participants may derive sexual gratification from the experience.]

entries.name: Breeding
entries.content: [What "breeding" means: Entails the act sexual intercourse for the sole purpose of inducing pregnancy and / or producing offspring.]

entries.name: Extreme Pregnancy
entries.content: [What "extreme pregnancy" means: The act of becoming pregnant with an incredible or unrealistic size and / or number of fetuses / eggs, often in an unrealistically short time span, and often to the point of immobility, or engaging in an RP in which at least one character fits such a description.]

entries.name: Heat/Rut
entries.content: [What "heat / rut" means: A character entering a state of heightened sexual arousal which often alters or overrides their inhibitions. May correspond with being more receptive to impregnation / the ability to impregnate.]

entries.name: Impregnation
entries.content: [What "impregnation" means: Expresses an interest in actions where impregnating a character is the focused act, actively trying to get another character pregnant in one form or another.]

entries.name: Male Pregnancy
entries.content: [What "male pregnancy" means: The act of a male identifying character becoming pregnant during the course of an RP, or engaging in an RP in which at least one male character is pregnant.]

entries.name: Oviposition
entries.content: [What "oviposition" means: Engaging in an RP in which at least one character will lay eggs through an orifice.]

entries.name: Pregnancy
entries.content: [What "pregnancy" means: Engaging in an RP in which at least one character is pregnant, and / or includes themes of pregnancy.]

entries.name: Risk Of Pregnancy
entries.content: [What "risk of pregnancy" means: Engaging in an RP in which there is an immediate and serious risk of at least one character becoming pregnant; often implies that at least one character does not want such a result.]

entries.name: Smegma
entries.content: [What "smegma" means: Expresses an interest in the build-up substance that generates on one's genitals (typically under foreskin and labia) due to a lack of maintained hygiene.]

entries.name: Bathroom Control
entries.content: [What "bathroom control" means: A situation in which a character controls when, how and where another character may use the bathroom in any fashion, typically as a form of control or degradation.]

entries.name: Hyper Watersports
entries.content: [What "hyper watersports" means: Producing unnatural amounts of urine, or using other means to obtain urine in huge, often unrealistic, amounts within an RP, the excretion of product thereof causing sexual stimulation and / or distress to one or more characters.]

entries.name: Marking
entries.content: [What "marking" means: The act of urinating on another character in order to mark them with your proprietary scent of urine, or being the recipient of such actions.]

entries.name: Watersports
entries.content: [What "watersports" means: Pertains to the inclusion of urine, or the expelling of urine, in any form, in the sexual context of an RP.]

entries.name: Gyaru Fetish
entries.content:
Gyaru Fetish (Inspired by Japanese Kawaii, Influenced in South Korea)
Though originating in Japan, the "gyaru" (cute, hyper-stylized femininity) aesthetic has been adapted and embraced in certain South Korean subcultures, leading to a fetish surrounding the "kawaii" (cute) look. Participants or fans are drawn to individuals who embrace this ultra-feminine style, characterized by youthful, exaggerated beauty with heavy makeup, dyed hair, and sometimes provocative schoolgirl-like fashion. The fetish focuses on the visual aspects of hyper-cuteness mixed with sexual allure, often playing into themes of innocence and seduction.
